SELECT t_product_price.id, t_product_price.`status`, t_product_price.product_price_no AS productPriceNo, t_product_price.product_class_no AS productClassNo, t_product_price.product_class_name AS productClassName, t_product_price.sku_no AS skuNo, t_product_price.sku_name AS skuName, t_product_price.materiel_no AS materielNo, t_product_price.materiel_name AS materielName, t_product_price.currency, t_product_price.trade_type AS tradeType, t_product_price.univalence_model AS univalenceModel, t_product_price.business_type AS businessType, t_product_price.effective_start_time AS effectiveStartTime, t_product_price.effective_end_time AS effectiveEndTime, t_product_price.org_no AS orgNo, t_product_price.org_name AS orgName, t_product_price.workflowid AS workflowid, t_product_price.company_no AS companyNo FROM t_product_price LEFT JOIN t_system_user ON t_product_price.create_by = t_system_user.id WHERE t_product_price.is_deleted = #{param.deleted} AND t_product_price.org_no IN
#{item}
AND t_system_user.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.userName}, '%')
AND t_product_price.org_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orgNo}, '%')
AND t_product_price.shbz = #{param.shbz}
AND t_product_price.`status` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.status}, '%')
AND t_product_price.product_price_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.productPriceNo}, '%')
AND t_product_price.product_class_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.productClassNo}, '%')
AND t_product_price.product_class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.productClassName}, '%')
AND t_product_price.sku_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.skuNo}, '%')
AND t_product_price.sku_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.skuName}, '%')
AND t_product_price.materiel_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.materielNo}, '%')
AND t_product_price.materiel_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.materielName}, '%')
AND t_product_price.currency LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.currency}, '%')
AND t_product_price.trade_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.tradeType}, '%')
AND t_product_price.univalence_model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.univalenceModel}, '%')
AND t_product_price.business_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.businessType}, '%')
AND t_product_price.effective_start_time LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.effectiveStartTime}, '%')
AND t_product_price.effective_end_time LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.effectiveEndTime}, '%')
AND t_product_price.org_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orgName}, '%')
AND t_product_price.dept_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deptNo}, '%')
AND t_product_price.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deptName}, '%')
ORDER BY t_product_price.gmt_modified DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_product_price_item (product_price_no, product_price_item_no, scheme_item_no, price, tax_price, depot_no, depot_name, currency_unit, benchmark_price, remark, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{productPriceNo}, #{productPriceItemNo}, #{schemeItemNo}, #{price}, #{taxPrice}, #{depotNo}, #{depotName}, #{currencyUnit}, #{benchmarkPrice}, #{remark}, #{gmtCreate}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_product_price_item SET t_product_price_item.product_price_no = #{productPriceNo}, t_product_price_item.product_price_item_no = #{productPriceItemNo}, t_product_price_item.scheme_item_no = #{schemeItemNo}, t_product_price_item.price = #{price}, t_product_price_item.tax_price = #{taxPrice}, t_product_price_item.depot_no = #{depotNo}, t_product_price_item.depot_name = #{depotName}, t_product_price_item.currency_unit = #{currencyUnit}, t_product_price_item.benchmark_price = #{benchmarkPrice}, t_product_price_item.remark = #{remark} WHERE t_product_price_item.id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(t_product_price.product_price_no) FROM t_product_price WHERE t_product_price.is_deleted = 0 AND t_product_price.user_name = #{userName} AND t_product_price.org_no = #{orgNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_product_price SET t_product_price.shbz = #{param.approvalStatus}, t_product_price.status = '审核完成' WHERE t_product_price.id = #{param.id}
mapper.select: SELECT t_system_org.org_no FROM t_system_org WHERE t_system_org.id = ( SELECT t_system_org.parent_id FROM t_system_org WHERE t_system_org.org_no = #{orgNo})

SELECT t_price_scheme_item.area_name AS areaName, t_price_scheme_item.delivery_place_name AS deliveryPlaceName, t_price_scheme_item.delivery_place_class_name AS deliveryPlaceClassName, t_price_scheme_item.distribution_way AS distributionWay, t_price_scheme_item.transport_way AS transportWay, t_price_scheme_item.pay_way AS payWay, t_price_scheme_item.currency, t_price_scheme_item.unit, t_product_price_item.price, t_product_price_item.tax_price AS taxPrice, t_product_price_item.depot_name AS depotName, t_product_price_item.currency_unit AS currencyUnit, t_product_price_item.benchmark_price AS benchmarkPrice, t_product_price_item.remark FROM t_product_price_item LEFT JOIN t_price_scheme_item ON t_product_price_item.scheme_item_no = t_price_scheme_item.scheme_item_no WHERE t_product_price_item.is_deleted = 0 AND t_price_scheme_item.is_deleted = 0 AND t_product_price_item.product_price_no = #{productPriceNo}
